name: The Twilight Zone
description: Tales of science fiction, fantasy and the occult, exploring humanity's hopes, despairs, prides and prejudices in metaphoric ways. Next stop ahead The Twilight Zone.

videos.title: The Comedian
videos.overview: Taking advice from a famous comedian, a stand-up comic makes fun of his own life - with unexpected results.

videos.title: Nightmare at 30,000 Feet
videos.overview: A journalist listens to a podcast detailing how the plane on which he's a passenger will disappear.

videos.title: Replay
videos.overview: A self-made lawyer and mother named Nina Harrison takes her son Dorian to his first year at college. Her old camcorder can rewind time, but can it help her ensure her son's future?

videos.title: A Traveler
videos.overview: On Christmas Eve in Iglaak, Alaska, a mysterious traveler wishes to be pardoned by Captain Lane Pendleton.

videos.title: The Wunderkind
videos.overview: A down-on-his-luck campaign manager is determined to get a kid elected as the President of the United States.

videos.title: Six Degrees of Freedom
videos.overview: A space crew preparing for the first human flight to Mars is faced with a life-altering decision… and its consequences.

videos.title: Not All Men
videos.overview: A meteor shower spreads infection across an entire town, affecting some of the inhabitants more than others.

videos.title: Point of Origin
videos.overview: A suburban housewife wants to go home. But where - and what - is home, really?

videos.title: The Blue Scorpion
videos.overview: Following the death of his dad, an anthropology professor finds the re-emergence of a gun called the Blue Scorpion which is about to become his most personal research project.

videos.title: Blurryman
videos.overview: A writer is haunted by a mysterious figure.

videos.title: Meet in the Middle
videos.overview: Lonely bachelor Phil finds meaningful human connection when he discovers a telepathic link to a stranger named Annie. Their connection quickly sparks a romance, but not everything is as it seems in this seemingly idyllic fantasy.

videos.title: Downtime
videos.overview: After a recent promotion to hotel manager, Michelle feels like she's on top of the world, but any cause for celebration is short lived when the nature of her reality is called into question.

videos.title: The Who of You
videos.overview: Struggling actor Harry risks everything to catch his big break, but an impulsive scheme takes a few turns no one saw coming.

videos.title: Ovation
videos.overview: The music career of struggling singer Jasmine takes off overnight after she witnesses a tragic incident. Jasmine begins receiving rapturous applause everywhere she goes, but she soon realizes the relentless recognition comes at a steep cost.

videos.title: Among the Untrodden
videos.overview: Transfer student Irene's unusual interests make her an easy target at her new all-girls boarding school until she discovers that popular classmate Madison possesses a unique talent.
At the outer reaches of the world, a team of scientists discover a new highly intelligent species, but its existence may endanger more than their research.

videos.title: A Human Face
videos.overview: A grieving couple's move is interrupted by an otherworldly encounter, leading them to second guess what's worth leaving behind.

videos.title: A Small Town
videos.overview: A quiet church handyman uncovers a magical scale model imbuing him with the power to help his struggling small town. But with the sleazy Mayor Conway taking all the credit, will Jason's good intentions be corrupted?

videos.title: Try, Try
videos.overview: When the quick-witted Claudia has a chance run-in with Mark at a museum, he dazzles her with his seemingly miraculous abilities. But after the true source of his charisma is revealed, the encounter takes a dark turn.

videos.title: You Might Also Like
videos.overview: Stay-at-home housewife Mrs. Warren looks forward to acquiring the widely marketed 'Egg,' an enigmatic device that promises to make everything better for everyone forever. But further investigation soon reveals the unsavory truth about this mysterious product.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 5 wins & 13 nominations total
